forum.title: Automation testing of TouchGFX based UI
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi Pritesh

Yes, we have been working on a UI test tool in Mjølner, like Johan said, which aims at fully automated tests that can even run on a CI server as part of the development process.

It is called *Dvergr*, and we tried to collect some technical information about it here: <https://mjolner.dk/dvergr>

Feel free to reach out if you would like to hear more about it :)

Kind regards

Bent Bisballe Nyeng

Mjølner Informatics A/S
forum.content_text:
Hi Team,

Is there any framework or lib support available from ST for automation testing of TouchGFX based UI either on simulator or on actual device?

If anyone has any idea or workaround, then please share!

Thanks
forum.author: Pritesh

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @Pritesh.

There is no framework provided by ST for doing that.

However, I know that one of our partners, Mjølner, works a lot with automated TouchGFX GUI testing and offers services in this area.
You can contact them to learn more.

Best regards,
Johan
